title: Scimplify raises $25M to challenge China’s grip on critical materials with AI
summary: Scimplify, an AI startup tackling critical materials supply, raised $25M and has tripled its annualized revenue to $200M as it expands in the U.S. to challenge China's dominance in this strategic sector.
content: Scimplify's annualized revenue run rate has tripled to $200 million as it eyes U.S. expansion.

zh.title: Scimplify融资2500万美元，用AI挑战中国对关键材料的垄断
zh.summary: AI初创公司Scimplify专注于关键材料供应，融资2500万美元，年收入翻三倍至2亿美元，同时在美国扩展业务，以挑战中国在战略性关键材料领域的主导地位。

title: The Tesla Roadster could have stayed vaporware
summary: After nearly a decade since Elon Musk's announcement, Tesla's next-generation Roadster is finally arriving, though timing is challenging amid high energy prices, political uncertainty, and slower EV sales.
content:
Imagine a light bar on this 2017 Roadster concept image, and you’ll start to see it. | Image: Tesla	

For a car that's supposed to be one of the fastest ever made, the new Tesla Roadster certainly took its sweet-ass time getting here.
It's been nearly a decade since Elon Musk made the surprise announcement about plans to build a next-gen Roadster. Now, the Tesla Roadster is finally expected to make its production-ready debut at an event in Waco, Texas - and the timing couldn't be worse.

zh.title: 特斯拉Roadster本可能永远停留在PPT阶段
zh.summary: 在埃隆·马斯克宣布近十年后，特斯拉下一代Roadster终于面世，但受高能源价格、政治不确定性和电动车销售放缓的影响，推出时机面临挑战。

title: Fairphone’s latest repairable earbuds are smaller, lighter, and longer-lasting
summary: Fairphone released Fairbuds 2, maintaining full repairability while delivering improved audio, nearly doubled battery life to 40 hours, and a 37% smaller case. The earbuds launch in UK/Europe at £99 and reach the U.S. on November 2nd.
content:
The Fairbuds 2 have had a total design revamp from the original pair.	

Repairable, ethical phone brand Fairphone has released its second pair of earbuds. The Fairbuds 2 are just as repairable as the first generation, but deliver improved audio and almost twice the battery life. The Fairbuds 2 are out now in the UK and Europe from £99 / €119, and a US launch at $119 will follow on November 2nd.
The Fairbuds 2 have been redesigned from the ground up, moving to a stemmed design, available in black or green, and a case that's 37 percent smaller than the first generation. Despite that shrinking hardware, Fairphone has almost doubled the buds' battery life, which now totals 40 hours without active noise cancellation …

zh.title: Fairphone最新可维修耳机更小更轻更耐用
zh.summary: Fairphone推出Fairbuds 2，保持完整的可维修性，同时提供改进的音质、电池续航时间翻倍至40小时，且外壳体积缩小37%。耳机在英国/欧洲地区以99英镑的价格推出，将于11月2日登陆美国市场。

title: Justice Department says North Koreans have infiltrated dozens of U.S. companies
summary: U.S. authorities warn that North Korean hackers subject to sanctions are increasingly targeting Americans to serve as intermediaries facilitating breached company data to Pyongyang. This represents a significant shift in North Korea's hacking strategy focused on infiltrating dozens of U.S. companies.
content: U.S. authorities warn that sanctioned hackers are increasingly targeting Americans to act as facilitators between breached U.S. companies and Pyongyang.

zh.title: 司法部：朝鲜人已入侵数十家美国公司
zh.summary: 美国当局警告称，受制裁的朝鲜黑客越来越多地针对美国人，让他们充当中介，便于将被入侵企业的数据转移到平壤。这标志着朝鲜黑客策略的重大转变，重点是入侵美国数十家公司。
